text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: p99 latency > 1200ms in ap-southeast-2 (5m window) • trigger count=3 • oncall=jordan

jordan: acked — jumping in now :wave:

maya: seeing p95->p99 gap on the http-proxy service, looks like tokenizers queue length spiking to 600

alex: kv-cache eviction rate shot up ~10x around the same time. logs show frequent OOM-ish evictions on sidecar. snippet:```evict_count=1845 delay_ms=1200 region=ap-southeast-2```

jordan: good call. alex, can you confirm if the eviction is the root or a symptom? any recent rollouts?

alex: no recent rollout in region, autoscaler activity increased but failed to spin a new pool due to quota limit on GPUs. error: "quota_exceeded: gpu_pools"

lee: i'm on it — checking quota dashboard and infra requests. if quota is the blocker we should divert traffic to fallback models while infra catches up

sam: starting model fallback now. routing rule: prod->model-xl to prod->model-l-lite for ap-southeast-2. issuing command:```redwood route set --region ap-southeast-2 --from model-xl --to model-lite --weight 100%```

maya: can someone warm the fallback? cold starts will make tail worse otherwise

sam: running warmup job:```jobs/warmup --model model-lite --region ap-southeast-2 --concurrency 10 --duration 120s```

jordan: monitoring dashboards — tokenizers queue dropped 40% after warmup kicked off, p99 trending down from 1250ms -> 720ms

alex: still seeing elevated evictions but traffic drop should reduce pressure. opened infra ticket to request temporary GPU quota bump: TKT-2891

lee: i can approve a burst request from reserved pool for 30m to stabilize — will coordinate with infra ops now

support-bot: Heads-up: customer-impact check — internal routing shows ~2.6% of requests experiencing >=1s latency in AP region in last 10m. no large customer errors reported yet. preparing a short customer blurb if we need to notify

jordan: thanks. tagging escalation path: if p99 > 1s persists for another 10m escalate to lee and oncall-rotation :point_up:

maya: quick note — a malformed batching config for a small tenant caused a hot shard on tokenizer. isolating that tenant now with cap 10rps using:```redwood quota set --tenant tenant-42 --region ap-southeast-2 --rps 10```

alex: eviction rate falling after tenant cap. p99 now ~550ms and p95 ~140ms. looks like mitigation working.

jordan: great. i'll keep the thread open for handoff. oncall->next is lee in 24m. lee, want to take a follow-up watch and close once metrics stable for 30m?

lee: will do. once infra confirms quota bump or pool borrow, we'll remove fallback routing and revert warmup. leave the ticket with TKT-2891 and i'll own the follow-through.

support-bot: drafted customer note: "We observed an elevated latency event in AP region that impacted a small fraction of requests. Traffic was temporarily routed to a fallback model and service performance has been restored. We're monitoring and will follow up if any customer-facing impact is identified." ready to send on approval.

jordan: approved. thanks everyone. switching to watch mode, will hand off to lee at shift change. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Alert resolved (p99 < 800ms) — incident closed by jordan at 1765433339
